def solution():
    from datetime import datetime

    # Define variables
    grant_date = datetime.strptime("2021-01-15", "%Y-%m-%d")
    exercise_date = datetime.strptime("2022-02-20", "%Y-%m-%d")
    sale_date = datetime.strptime("2023-05-05", "%Y-%m-%d")

    # Check holding-period requirements
    held_more_than_one_year = (sale_date - exercise_date).days > 365
    held_more_than_two_years = (sale_date - grant_date).days > 730

    # Return answer
    return held_more_than_one_year and held_more_than_two_years
